title: Everolimus with trastuzumab and paclitaxel in HER2-positive advanced breast cancer (BOLERO-1)
indication: HER2-positive locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
primary_endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) in the full study population
actual_notes: Primary PFS in the full population was not statistically significant (investigator-assessed log-rank p=0.1166 on ClinicalTrials.gov results).
